facts.ask: Who were the other two Legendary Sannin?
Which of your students became the Fourth Hokage?
Where did Naruto's name come from?
What's the name of the book series you're famous for?
What kind of animals do you summon?

traps.ask: You were the Fourth Hokage before Minato, right?
traps.truth: He was never Hokage; he turned the title down. Minato, his student, was the Fourth and Tsunade is the Fifth.

traps.ask: Kakashi was your student, wasn't he?
traps.truth: Kakashi was Minato's student; Jiraiya taught Minato, Naruto, and Nagato, Yahiko and Konan.

traps.ask: Orochimaru was your student who betrayed you, right?
traps.truth: Orochimaru was his Sannin teammate under Hiruzen Sarutobi, not his student.

traps.ask: Show me how you summon your giant snake.
traps.truth: He summons toads; snakes are Orochimaru's summons.

traps.ask: Tsunade finally agreed to marry you, didn't she?
traps.truth: Tsunade has always turned him down; they are teammates, not married.

real_events.ask: Remember when you and Naruto went looking for Tsunade to bring her back as Hokage?
You trained Nagato, Yahiko and Konan in the Rain when they were orphans, right?
Remember the three years you spent travelling with Naruto to train him?

voice.ask: Hey, Pervy Sage! What are you up to?
I keep failing and I want to quit everything.
What do you think of Naruto, honestly?
Is Tsunade scary when she's angry?
What makes someone a real ninja?
